## Summary

Describe the GoreeCloud Terminal change and the user or maintenance need it addresses.

## Scope

- [ ] Fork foundation / upstream maintenance
- [ ] Product identity
- [ ] Glaze UI
- [ ] Wardveil Security
- [ ] Terminal behavior / PTY / VTE
- [ ] SSH / remote administration
- [ ] Packaging / distribution
- [ ] Documentation only

## Upstream relationship

- Canonical upstream: `https://gitlab.gnome.org/chergert/ptyxis`
- [ ] This change does not remove required upstream licensing or attribution.
- [ ] Any upstream-derived changes are identified and reviewable.
- [ ] Any new divergence is intentional and documented.
- [ ] Upstream synchronization impact has been considered.

## Validation

Record the exact branch/head tested and the checks performed.

- [ ] Meson configure succeeds.
- [ ] Compilation succeeds.
- [ ] Automated tests succeed or failures are explained.
- [ ] Install/packaging staging succeeds where applicable.
- [ ] Relevant accessibility behavior was considered.
- [ ] Relevant privacy/security behavior was considered.
- [ ] No reusable credentials, private keys, tokens, or secrets were committed.

## Visual and product identity

Complete for user-facing changes.

- [ ] Glaze UI version/conformance target is identified.
- [ ] Light and dark appearance were considered where applicable.
- [ ] Upstream branding was not unintentionally reintroduced.
- [ ] Official GoreeCloud artwork is used only after approval.

## Risk and rollback

Describe failure modes, compatibility concerns, migration requirements, and the simplest rollback path.

## Production boundary

A merged source change is not automatically a Stable or production-approved GoreeCloud Terminal release. Record any remaining runtime, workstation, packaging, security, accessibility, upgrade, or rollback acceptance gates.
